headline: Blueface baby mama admits she lied to Blueface when he was in jail about getting his face tatted
body: DJ Akademiks reports on a viral Instagram post where a 'blueface baby mama' claims she lied to Blueface during his jail stint. She allegedly told him she got his face tatted, but actually went and tatted NBA Youngboy's face instead. The post, with over 3,994 likes and 616 comments, shows the drama unfolding in hip-hop culture. The caption includes crying emojis, highlighting the emotional stakes.
